item.title: CNMI joins national discussions on coastal resilience
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. (BECQ) — Representatives from the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands joined coastal program managers from 36 states and territories last week for the NOAA Annual Program Managers Meeting and the Coastal States Organization Spring Meeting 2026. The post CNMI joins national discussions on coastal resilience appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: King-Hinds, Gillen, Mackenzie introduce bipartisan bill to protect children from counterfeit car seats
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. (Press Release) — Delegate Kimberlyn King-Hinds, R-MP, U.S. Congresswoman Laura Gillen, D-NY, both members of the House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, and U.S. Congressman Ryan Mackenzie, R-PA, introduced bipartisan legislation to protect children from counterfeit and noncompliant car seats. The post King-Hinds, Gillen, Mackenzie introduce bipartisan bill to protect children from counterfeit car seats appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Galvin Deleon Guerrero: Find solutions, not blame
item.description: "The Saipan Chamber of Commerce is to be commended for holding its 4th Economic Forum, especially for engaging stakeholders from throughout the Marianas, including all mayors from Saipan, Tinian, and Luta, as well as partners from Guam. However, it was disappointing and disheartening to see the Delegate deliver closing remarks that focused on finding blame instead of finding solutions for the economic challenges that the CNMI is facing." The post Galvin Deleon Guerrero: Find solutions, not blame

item.title: Garapan roundabout construction officially underway
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang and other CNMI officials on Thursday shoveled sand at a groundbreaking ceremony marking the start of construction on a roundabout at the intersection of Beach Road and Micro Beach Road in Garapan. The post Garapan roundabout construction officially underway appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Apatang vetoes bill redefining PSS general revenues
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang on Wednesday vetoed House Bill 24-33, which proposes to statutorily define 25% of general revenues for the Public School System. The post Apatang vetoes bill redefining PSS general revenues appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Mendiola will not seek office in 2026
item.description: LIEUTENANT Gov. Dennis James C. Mendiola said he will not seek elected office in 2026 but will continue serving through the end of his term while addressing the criminal case against him. The post Mendiola will not seek office in 2026 appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: CNMI disputes US House Republicans’ letter on EVS-TAP
item.description: THIRTY‑FOUR U.S. House Republicans are urging the secretaries of Homeland Security, State, and the Interior to shut down federal entry programs that allow Chinese nationals to visit the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands without visas, arguing that the programs have fueled large‑scale birth tourism and created national security risks. The post CNMI disputes US House Republicans’ letter on EVS-TAP appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Indo-Pacific commander backs CNMI request for federal dialogue
item.description: U.S. Indo-Pacific Commander Adm. Samuel J. Paparo supports CNMI leaders’ request for an executive-level dialogue with the Trump administration on urgent economic issues facing the Commonwealth amid the ongoing military buildup and geopolitical tensions in the region. The post Indo-Pacific commander backs CNMI request for federal dialogue appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.
